modules.module_title: Maintain safe and secure working environment

pcs.pc_description: identify hazardous activities and the possible causes of risks or accidents in the workplace
implement safe working practices for dealing with hazards to ensure safety of self and others
conduct regular checks of the machines with support of the maintenance team to identify potential hazards
ensure that all the tools/equipment/fasteners/spare parts are arranged as per specifications/utility into proper trays, cabinets, lockers as mentioned in the 5S guidelines/work instructions
organise safety drills or training sessions to create awareness amongst others on the identified risks and safety practices
fill daily check sheet to report improvements done and risks identified
ensure that relevant safety boards/signs are placed on the shop floor for the safety of self and others
report any identified breaches in health, safety and security policies and procedures to the designated person
ensure workplace, equipment, restrooms etc. are sanitized regularly
ensure team is aware about hygiene and sanitation regulations and following them on the shop floor
ensure availability of running water, hand wash and alcohol-based sanitizers at the workplace
report advanced hygiene and sanitation issues to appropriate authority
follow stress and anxiety management techniques and support employees to cope with stress, anxiety etc
wear and dispose PPEs regularly and appropriately
ensure recyclable, non-recyclable and hazardous wastes are segregated as per SOP
ensure proper mechanism is followed while collecting and disposing of non-recyclable, recyclable and reusable waste
ensure malfunctioning (fumes/sparks/emission/vibration/noise) and lapse in maintenance of equipment are resolved effectively
prepare and analyze material and energy audit reports to decipher excessive consumption of material and water
identify possibilities of using renewable energy and environment friendly fuels
identify processes where material and energy/electricity utilization can be optimized

modules.module_title: Manage manpower and material for the shift/line

pcs.pc_description: allocate requisite manpower based on skill matrix to achieve production targets
support Shift In Charge/Process head/Shop head in finalizing the shift rosters for the week and month based on the production plan
maintain the information on leaves/in-out time and shift/line overtime of the team and share the information with the concerned authorities as per the organisational procedures
send inventory requirements to stores and purchase department and follow up with them to ensure the timely receipt of materials (Spares, Consumables, etc.)

ensure that the operators and helpers have the required tools and equipment at the start of production process
ensure optimal resource utilization

• implement corrective actions to reduce losses and wastages during shift operation and • minimum rejection of components

support the maintenance team in finalizing and executing the preventive maintenance schedule for the shop/line
support the incharge/Engineer/Shop Head in analysing the various data sheets and reports related to production, maintenance, manpower deployment etc.
analyse possible areas of improvements in production line and identify corrective measures to address the gaps
carry out audit of production process for capability of each operation and prepare reports on the non-compliances for the regulatory authorities by following organizational procedures
implement various process improvement techniques like Kaizen, 5S, Poka Yoke, TQM etc. on the production line to rectify the failure and gaps in the production process
analyse machine breakdown trends and current maintenance process to identify areas of improvement and corrective actions for improving the same
monitor and review the effectiveness of process improvement techniques and corrective actions on production and prepare reports for the regulatory authorities on the same
encourage team members/operators to suggest quality improvement measures through suggestion schemes, evaluate feasibility of the ideas and discuss their implementation with seniors
conduct daily floor meeting/morning meetings/staff meetings to communicate the information such as production targets, new guidelines, new processes etc. to team
organise training sessions for the operators and technicians to improve their skills and knowledge on new techniques and methods
resolve grievances within the team or escalate them to the concerned authorities if they are beyond the scope
counsel employees for any work related issues or any personal problems highlighted by the employee
